headline: Executive order extends the life of certain federal advisory committees that would otherwise expire.
what_it_does: This order keeps certain existing federal advisory committees running for a set period of time. Advisory committees are groups of outside experts and citizens that give advice to the President or federal agencies. Without renewal, many of these committees would end on a fixed date. The title alone does not say which committees are included or for how long.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the federal advisory committees named in the order
who_it_affects.how: They can keep serving and giving advice because their committees continue to exist.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that support these committees
who_it_affects.how: They keep providing staff and resources to run the committees.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 23, 2011; the end date for the extension is not stated in the title.
